rows.description: Hello AI World guide to deploying deep-learning inference networks and deep vision primitives with TensorRT and NVIDIA Jetson.
Production-grade C++ edge AI engine for video analytics and on-device VLM across Sophon, Rockchip RKNN, and x86, with visual orchestration, real-time OSD, events, and reproducible benchmarks.

NVIDIA AI Blueprint for video search and summarization (VSS) is a GPU-accelerated reference architecture for building video analytics agents with real-time verified alerts, visual Q&A, and automated reporting. The VSS Blueprint uses vision language models (VLMs) such as NVIDIA Cosmos, LLMs such as NVIDIA Nemotron, RAG, and NVIDIA NIMs.
Python framework that facilitates the quick development of complex video analysis applications and other series-processing based applications in a multiprocessing environment.
